# Module Technical Reference Template

**Document ID:** TEMPLATE-TECHNICAL-REFERENCE

**Schema version:** 1

**Kind:** reference

**Lifecycle:** current

**Subject:** template for a normative module technical reference

**Surface:** template

**Boundary:** global

**Authority role:** non-normative

**Mutation:** authored

**Indexing:** exclude

Cover only applicable concerns: purpose and mental model, architecture and
package boundary, public entry points, examples, lifecycle, ownership,
concurrency, cancellation, disposal, errors and recovery, state transitions,
configuration, platform and target differences, wire or serialization
contracts, security assumptions, extension points, non-goals, edge cases,
scenarios, migrations, issues, and validation expectations.

Reconcile every current claim against source, project files, compiled API, and
relevant tests. Omit inapplicable sections instead of leaving decorative blanks.
